title: Halal-Friendly Smoky Brazilian Milk Bake
description: A smoky, creamy Brazilian-inspired dessert featuring a molten milk custard topped with a caramelized sugar crust, all within a halal-friendly framework.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the milk, granulated sugar, cinnamon powder, and smoked ground coffee. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and set aside.
Remove the milk mixture from the heat and temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm milk into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 6 (1/2 cup) ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool in an ice bath for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the top of each ramekin and sprinkle with a pinch of sea salt.
Return the ramekins to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the tops are caramelized.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Drizzle with heavy cream and sprinkle with a pinch of cinnamon powder.
